properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 11 at 12:19PM MST until September 11 at 12:45PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 119 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Leupp, or 25
miles northwest of Winslow, moving northeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Leupp and Sunrise.

This includes State Route 99 between mile markers 65 and 71.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 11 at 2:17PM CDT until September 11 at 3:00PM CDT by NWS Shreveport LA
properties.description:
SVRSHV

The National Weather Service in Shreveport has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
East Central McCurtain County in southeastern Oklahoma...

* Until 300 PM CDT.

* At 217 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 8 miles northeast
of Broken Bow, or 17 miles west of De Queen, moving southeast at 10
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Eagletown.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

If on or near a lake, get away from the water and move indoors or
inside a vehicle. Remember, lightning can strike out to 15 miles from
the parent thunderstorm. If you can hear thunder, you are close
enough to be struck by lightning. Move to safe shelter now! Do not be
caught on the water in a thunderstorm.

properties.areaDesc: Coastal Waters From  Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola FL out to 20 Nm; Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 11 at 3:31PM EDT until September 11 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal Waters From  Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola FL out to 20
Nm...
Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 500 PM EDT.

* At 331 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from near K Tower
to 9 nm southwest of V Tower, moving northeast at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats...damage
vessels...and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34
knots...suddenly higher waves...frequent lightning...and
heavy downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
V Tower and K Tower.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 11 at 9:20AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Horse Creek near Arcadia at SR 72.

* WHEN...From late Sunday night until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The access road to Hidden Oak is
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 AM EDT Friday the stage was 7.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
Monday morning and continue rising to 12.2 feet Monday morning.
Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.2
feet on 11/24/1997.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 930 PM EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT FROM LATE SUNDAY NIGHT UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 11 at 12:31PM MST until September 11 at 3:45PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...

* Until 345 PM MST.

* At 1231 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain from Clay Springs to north of Show Low. Between 1.5 and
2.5 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to
0.5 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Show Low, Taylor, Schoens Lake, Linden, Ned Lake, Fool Hollow Lake,
Telephone Lake, Pintail Lake, Pinedale, Clay Springs, White
Mountain Lakes Estates, White Mountain Lake Estates and White
Mountain Lake Airport.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 322 and 336. State Route 77
between mile markers 343 and 351.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Fool Hollow Lake Recreation Area Campground.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Dodson Wash, Pinedale Wash, Linden Draw, Show Low Creek, Hog Wash,
Cottonwood Wash, Rocky Arroyo, Stinson Wash and Silver Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 3:45 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 3:45 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
